old: - `open-kanban-decision-making.md`, Joseph Hurtado / AgileLion Institute (*Open Kanban*, Release 1.00 Rev A). The Kanban-flavoured complement to Scrum-flavoured Agile. Five values condition the team's decision-making (Respect for people enables pull-based scheduling; Courage enables upward correction; Focus on Value frames the criterion; Communication and Collaboration package the engagement; Holistic / Systemic Approach disciplines what counts as improvement). Four practices structure the decision moments (Visualize the workflow makes work decideable; Lead using a team approach without role restructuring; Reduce the Batch Size as forward-looking per-stage decision rule; Learn and improve continuously). Signature contrarian position: WIP-limiting is downstream of batch-size reduction, not the primary lever — "Open Kanban does not ask you to limit WIP, but it does request that you 'Reduce the Batch Size of your Efforts.'" Explicit lineage to Deming + Goldratt (holistic / systemic), Kent Beck (courage), Reinertsen (batch-size), Cockburn (information radiators), TPS / Lean (Muri / Muda). Authoritativeness caveat: Open Kanban is the only clean-CC Kanban methodology specification in this corpus; canonical Kanban authorities (Anderson, Burrows, Reinertsen) are not in the corpus due to non-redistributable licences. **CC BY 3.0 Unported — open distribution; no Share-Alike obligation.**
new: - `open-kanban-decision-making.md`, Joseph Hurtado / AgileLion Institute (*Open Kanban*, Release 1.00 Rev A). The Kanban-flavoured complement to Scrum-flavoured Agile. Signature contrarian position: WIP-limiting is downstream of batch-size reduction, not the primary lever — "Open Kanban does not ask you to limit WIP, but it does request that you 'Reduce the Batch Size of your Efforts.'"
